description: This Java source file defines the class 'LocalStorageService' which implements local file system-based storage functionalities as the default implementation of 'StorageService' in the OpenMRS project. It provides methods for storing, retrieving, deleting, and listing data files within a specified directory, along with methods for fetching file metadata.

classes.name: LocalStorageService
classes.description: A service class that provides local file system storage functionalities, implementing the 'StorageService' interface, supporting data persistence, retrieval, deletion, and metadata fetching within a specified directory.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves an InputStream for the data associated with the given key.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata (size, mime type, filename, creation time) for the specified data file identified by the key.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Lists all keys in the storage that match a given module/group and prefix.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Stores data from an InputStream under a generated key, with optional filename metadata.

methods.name: purgeData
methods.description: Deletes the data associated with the specified key from storage.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a data item with the given key exists in storage.
